seo.title: VTeleprompter — Teleprompter Studio
seo.description: Read your script with auto-scroll and record yourself in a clean, distraction-free web teleprompter studio.

camera.unsupported: Your browser does not support the camera. Open this page over https or localhost.
camera.errorSuffix: ). Grant camera permission and reload the page.
camera.noMicAudio: Couldn't get the microphone — the video will have no sound.
camera.noDevice: No camera or microphone available to record.
camera.unsupportedRecording: Your browser does not support audio or video recording.
camera.micDenied: Microphone permission is needed to record.
camera.inUse: Your camera or microphone is being used by another app. Close it and try again.
camera.overconstrained: The selected camera settings aren't supported. Try a lower resolution.

desktopChromium: Click the lock / info icon (red box) at the left of the address bar.
Turn on Camera and Microphone, or click Reset permissions.
desktopEdge: Click the info icon (red box) at the left of the address bar.
Turn on Camera and Microphone, or click Reset to default.
desktopFirefox: Click the permissions icon at the left of the address bar.
Clear the block for Camera and Microphone.
desktopSafari: Safari menu → Settings for This Website.
Set Camera and Microphone to Allow.
iosSafari: Tap the page-settings button (red box) at the left of the address bar.
Open Website Settings, then set Camera and Microphone to Allow.
iosOther: Open Settings → this browser → turn on Camera and Microphone.
Come back and reload the page.
android: Tap the tune icon (red box) at the left of the address bar.
fallback: Allow Camera and Microphone, then reload.
